acceptance.title: Define terms, context ownership, evidence classes, separate profiles, and assessment alternatives
acceptance.positiveCase: Business objects, internal domain events, integration projections, envelopes, and commands remain distinct.
acceptance.negativeCase: A type suffix, topic name, or in-process handler alone does not classify business meaning or public exposure.

acceptance.title: Map current supported facts and declarations to the proposed inventory with limitations
acceptance.positiveCase: C#, TypeScript, SQL, ce.v1, and reviewed glossary evidence have exact base-revision citations.
acceptance.negativeCase: Dynamic SQL, unsupported serialization, recursive shapes, and missing runtime routing remain unknown.

acceptance.title: Draft strict versioned identity, nested-shape, ambiguity, exposure, applicability, ceiling, and stale-review contract
acceptance.positiveCase: Source/tool/rubric/glossary/context/policy identities are separately versioned and assessment inputs are explicit.
acceptance.negativeCase: Unknown fields, stale semantic reviews, absent evidence, and invalid profile links cannot be silently accepted.

acceptance.title: Seal nine separately declared synthetic expected cases for projection, exposure, ambiguity, events, commands, and unsupported shapes
acceptance.positiveCase: Each named case has a pre-authored expected classification, exposure verdict, grade state, and relation outcome.
acceptance.negativeCase: Fixtures are not source-extractor outputs, measured accuracy, real exposure findings, or runtime-grade evidence.

acceptance.title: Reject unsafe mutations and prove stable canonical outputs
acceptance.positiveCase: Every valid synthetic case evaluates to its separately declared oracle and repeated canonical bytes are identical.
acceptance.negativeCase: Invented context/field links, false propagation, false no-leakage, gate averaging, unknown-as-bronze, stale glossary, and envelope-only promotion fail.

acceptance.title: Define an expert-reviewed gold set and honest evaluation measures
acceptance.positiveCase: Precision/recall, unsupported rate, shape correctness, and reviewer agreement have explicit denominators and labels.
acceptance.negativeCase: No actual gold set or measured accuracy is claimed.

acceptance.title: Recommend one demand-gated bounded pilot with prerequisites and owner decisions
acceptance.positiveCase: The pilot requires approved context/glossary/policy/review inputs and a bounded owner-selected repository.
acceptance.negativeCase: No extractor, grader, schema/v1 change, extra issue, or automatic follow-on implementation is started.

sourceAnchors.claim: ce.v1 contains generic MessageContract, Channel, PUBLISHES, CONSUMES, derivation, resolution, and evidence fields, not DDD classification or field-flow proof.
PUBLISHES and CONSUMES can target channels or message contracts within existing node kinds.
C# uses Roslyn project compilations without running analyzed code; missing references produce partial diagnostics.
EF entity-to-table and Service Bus publish/consume links are rule/configuration evidence, not proof of business meaning or live consumers.
SQL parser declarations include tables, views, columns, routines, static ranges, and an explicit dynamic-body marker.
SQL is statically tokenized and dynamic SQL creates an incomplete-coverage diagnostic.
TypeScript record views mirror ce.v1 identity/evidence/derivation and do not add reviewed business semantics.
Name groups are not business meaning; exact human assertions stay distinct from call/read/write/channel context and become stale on revision change.
Contract declarations and standards do not prove deployment, traffic, compatibility, or business meaning; versions and evidence identities stay explicit.

constraints: This package proposes a research model and synthetic contract checks; it does not implement a semantic extractor, production grader, or source scanner.
The proposed bronze/silver/gold/platinum labels are project proposals, not DDD standards, security certifications, or medallion data-processing tiers.
Facts, model suggestions, human reviews, exposure decisions, and maturity results are separate evidence classes.
Context, field, projection, and consumer relationships require source evidence or a current reviewed assertion; names, calls, topics, and schemas do not establish them.
Unknown, unassessed, and insufficient evidence never silently become bronze or a safe exposure verdict.
A confirmed policy violation is a non-averagable hard stop; applicability requires rationale and cannot waive prohibited exposure.
Gold and platinum require current reviewed context-scoped ubiquitous language; spelling and model suggestions are not substitutes.
Internal domain events do not need a broker, outbox, external consumer, CloudEvents, or AsyncAPI to qualify for an applicable high profile.
Intentional event-carried state is not automatically leakage; field names and envelopes alone are not semantic proof.
Unsupported dynamic, generated, external, and recursive shapes remain explicit uncertainty, not silent no-leakage evidence.
Cryptographic hashes bind bytes but do not establish source authenticity or reviewer authorization.
Do not modify ce.v1, runtime extractors, dependencies, shared build wiring, MADR indexes, or the primary checkout.
